justifications.clinical.clinicalOutcomes: Wound center certification linked to limb salvage outcomes; PT/OT wound care certification-specific comparison not available.
justifications.clinical.efficiency: Multi-day wound care course plus exam (CWS/CWOCN); moderate time and cost.
justifications.clinical.caseloadApplicability: Applicable in wound care centers, home health, and long-term care; limited in outpatient ortho or neuro settings.
justifications.clinical.reimbursement: Wound care has significant billing codes; CWS supports documentation for wound debridement and management; commercial and Medicare cover.
justifications.clinical.marketDemand: High employer demand in wound care centers, home health, and SNF settings; frequently listed as required.
justifications.clinical.patientSatisfaction: Patients with chronic wounds value specialized care; healing progress is motivating.
justifications.business.cashPayViability: Wound care patients are elderly, comorbid, and insurance/Medicare-dependent; essentially zero cash market.
justifications.business.pricingLeverage: Commodity reimbursement environment; little premium upside.
justifications.business.marketDifferentiation: Relatively rare PT subspecialty; differentiates within acute/SNF settings.
justifications.business.ownerLeverage: Hard to build a private practice around wound care; institutional setting required.
justifications.business.marketDemand: No consumer-driven demand; strictly clinical referral.
justifications.business.efficiency: Moderate cost and exam preparation time.
justifications.academicClinical.facultyRecognition: Recognized as legitimate specialty content area, useful for integumentary curriculum coverage.
justifications.academicClinical.scholarship: Steady literature on wound healing, lymphedema, and integumentary PT.
justifications.academicClinical.teachingValue: Covers a required CAPTE content area programs must staff.
justifications.academicClinical.evidenceDepth: Strong evidence base in wound healing and compression therapy.
justifications.academicClinical.facultyDemand: Niche; only some programs actively seek wound expertise.
justifications.academicClinical.efficiency: Reasonable cost relative to filling a curricular gap.
